sentiment.rationale: This is a pre-earnings digest, so the score reflects market expectations rather than guidance. The document describes a stock that has rallied 21.2% over the trailing year and is near its 52-week high, with analyst estimates having been raised (multiple target price increases). This elevated bar increases the risk of a negative surprise even on decent results.
